newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish police arrest five young ETA supporters.
newsitem.headline: Spanish police arrest five young ETA supporters.

text.p: Spanish police broke up a violent youth group supporting ETA Basque separatists and arrested five of its alleged ringleaders, the Interior Ministry said in a statement on Tuesday.

It said the so-called "Y" group, was one of the most violent to be dismantled this year and had caused some 200 million pesetas ($1.5 million) in property damage. The group operated mostly in the Navarre region, which is partly Basque.

The five people arrested ranged in age from 16 to 21 years. They were accused of participating directly or indirectly in burning banks, automatic tellers, trucks, buses and an attack on the marine command centre in San Sebastian.
ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) has killed some 800 people in the 28 years it has fought for Basque independence.
